# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

**Concept**: A single-screen HTML5 canvas game where the player pilots a ship to dodge incoming asteroids.

- **Controls**: Arrow keys or WASD to move the ship.
- **Gameplay**: Asteroids spawn from the edges and move toward the center with increasing speed.
- **Lose Condition**: Collision with any asteroid ends the game.
- **Scoring**: Survival time (seconds) and optional fuel pickups increase the score.

The game is simple to implement with canvas drawing, basic physics, and a game loop.

1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game with enhanced graphics
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:    if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:    // Set canvas size
8:    const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:    const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:    // Generate simple starfield for background
11:    const stars = Array.from({length: 100}, () => ({
12:      x: Math.random() * width,
13:      y: Math.random() * height,
14:      radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
15:    }));
16:    // Particle array for ship thrust
17:    const particles = [];
18:    // Audio setup
19:    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
20:    function playTone(freq, duration) {
21:      const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:      const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:      oscillator.type = 'square';
24:      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
25:      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:      oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
27:      oscillator.start();
28:      oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
29:    }
30:    let thrustCooldown = 0;
31:    function playThrust() {
32:      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
33:      playTone(200, 0.05);
34:    }
35:    function playExplosion() {
36:      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
37:      playTone(100, 0.4);
38:    }
39: 
40:   // Ship definition
41:   const ship = {
42:     x: width / 2,
43:     y: height / 2,
44:     size: 20,
45:     speed: 4,
46:     dx: 0,
47:     dy: 0,
48:     update() {
49:       this.x = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(width - this.size, this.x + this.dx));
50:       this.y = Math.max(this.size, Math.min(height - this.size, this.y + this.dy));
51:     },
52:     draw() {
53:       // Ship with gradient fill and outline for better visibility
54:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y - this.size, this.x, this.y + this.size);
55:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
56:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
57:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
58:       ctx.beginPath();
59:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.size);
60:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.size, this.y + this.size);
61:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.size, this.y + this.size);
62:       ctx.closePath();
63:       ctx.fill();
64:       // white outline
65:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
66:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
67:       ctx.stroke();
68:     },
69:   };
70: 
71:   // Input handling
72:   const keys = {};
73:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
74:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
75:   function handleInput() {
76:     // Generate thrust particles when moving
77:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w || keys.ArrowDown || keys.s || keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a || keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) {
78:        // particle emitted from rear of ship based on direction
79:        const angle = Math.atan2(ship.dy, ship.dx) + Math.PI; // opposite to movement
80:        const speed = 1;
81:        particles.push({
82:          x: ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * ship.size,
83:          y: ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * ship.size,
84:          vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
85:          vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
86:          life: 30,
87:          radius: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
88:        });
89:        playThrust();
90:      }
91:     asteroids.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random() * 10});
92:   }
93: 
94:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
95:     asteroidTimer += dt;
96:     if (asteroidTimer > spawnInterval) {
97:       spawnAsteroid();
98:       asteroidTimer = 0;
99:     }
100:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
101:       const a = asteroids[i];
102:       a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
103:       // Remove if off-screen
104:       if (a.x < -30 || a.x > width + 30 || a.y < -30 || a.y > height + 30) {
105:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
106:       }
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   function drawStars() {
111:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
112:     stars.forEach(s => {
113:       ctx.beginPath();
114:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
115:       ctx.fill();
116:     });
117:   }
118: 
119:   function drawAsteroids() {
120:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
121:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
122:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
123:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
124:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
125:       ctx.beginPath();
126:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
127:       ctx.fill();
128:     });
129:   }
130: 
131:   function updateParticles() {
132:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
133:       const p = particles[i];
134:       p.x += p.vx;
135:       p.y += p.vy;
136:       p.life--;
137:       if (p.life <= 0) {
138:         particles.splice(i, 1);
139:       }
140:     }
141:   }
142: 
143:   function drawParticles() {
144:     particles.forEach(p => {
145:       const alpha = p.life / 30;
146:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
147:       ctx.beginPath();
148:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
149:       ctx.fill();
150:     });
151:   }
152: 
153:   function checkCollision() {
154:     for (const a of asteroids) {
155:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
156:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
157:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
158:       if (dist < a.r + ship.size) {
159:         return true;
160:       }
161:     }
162:     return false;
163:   }
164: 
165:   let lastTime = performance.now();
166:   let gameOver = false;
167:   let score = 0;
168:   function loop(now) {
169:     const dt = now - lastTime;
170:     lastTime = now;
171:     if (!gameOver) {
172:       handleInput();
173:       ship.update();
174:       updateAsteroids(dt);
175:       if (checkCollision()) {
176:         gameOver = true;
177:         playExplosion();
178:       }
179:       score += dt / 1000;
180:     }
181:     // Render
182:     // Black background
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
184:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
185:     drawStars();
186:     updateParticles();
187:     drawParticles();
188:     drawAsteroids();
189:     ship.draw();
190:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
191:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
192:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
193:     if (gameOver) {
194:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
195:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
196:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
197:     } else {
198:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199:     }
200:   }
201:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202: })();

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
